
Use the server image built from this checkout before recording
Image: conda-presto:docs-demo

Run the container on a loopback-only random port
$ docker run --detach --publish 127.0.0.1::8000 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --env CONDA_PRESTO_PLATFORMS=linux-64 conda-presto:docs-demo

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:32770/health
{"status":"ok"}
$ curl --fail --silent --show-error 'http://127.0.0.1:32770/resolve?spec=zlib&channel=conda-forge&platform=linux-64' > result.json

$ jq '[.[] | {platform, error, packages: [.packages[].name]}]' result.json
[
  {
    "platform": "linux-64",
    "error": null,
    "packages": [
      "libzlib",
      "zlib"
    ]
  }
]

The container resolved the requested Linux environment
